title: Chain inspection: Peak ticket
topics: Linked lists, binary trees and search trees
summary: Traverse the supplied acyclic linked list from head to tail and produce its node values in that order. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.
descriptionMd:
Index cards are joined by individual links rather than stored in numbered drawer slots. Mina is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

Traverse the supplied acyclic linked list from head to tail and produce its node values in that order.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement chainInspectionPeakTicket(head, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Linked traversal. Traverse the supplied acyclic linked list from head to tail and produce its node values in that order. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.
Lists are acyclic. Trees use level-order JSON with null for missing children; [] is an empty root. The runner supplies nodes with val/next or val/left/right.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with linked traversal. What state describes the portion you have already processed?
Traverse the supplied acyclic linked list from head to tail and produce its node values in that order. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [7,-3,7,0,12]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 12.
The derived sequence is [4,4,-2,4]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 4.
The derived sequence is []. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 0.

overview: Optimize: Linked traversal. Build the sequence once, then report exactly what the inspection card requests.
